declaring_sources.harness: D05 attempt pg_harness (imported via pythonpath, never copied)
declaring_sources.store_schema: migrations/v4_d05 (read-only; D06 adds a separate recovery schema)

all_completion_and_external_effects_reso.mechanism: the checkpoint attempt is committed before the guarded work so a crash cannot erase that work started, every attempt row is append-only, and all 84 D05 store tests ran green as the regression

governing_schemas_authority_boundaries_f.mechanism: the migration is one transaction with a preflight that refuses an absent D05 or a second apply, reuses D05's own domains and append-only guard, and journals both migrations with catalog-inventory content hashes that re-derive on the live server

happy_negative_crash_resume_adversarial_.mechanism: crash scenarios are proven with real aborted transactions against real PostgreSQL: a mid-work crash leaves a visible open attempt with observed-vs-expected counts, a crash during sealing leaves no checkpoint, tampering with constraints, functions or the journal is detected by digest mismatch, and recovery's only exits are seal-and-close or abandon-with-reason

no_candidate_model_prompt_backend_or_hoo.mechanism: seal_and_close_attempt reads run and generation from the attempt so an attempt cannot seal a generation it never covered, and it refuses unless the expected candidate count equals the lineage rows actually persisted

independent_review.evidence: review.md (author: parallel agent; reviewer: primary session; actor_independence between author and reviewer holds, external certification does not)
